recommends.title: Draw Steel: Death Tracker
recommends.reason: [Combat Tools] Keeps track of who falls: deaths announced in chat with an undo, the right minions taken from a squad, and the fallen left where they fell.

recommends.title: Draw Steel: Battle Log
recommends.reason: [Combat Tools] Draws each turn, round and fight into the chat log and folds away what's finished, and makes the chat cards match the dark theme.

recommends.title: Tagger
recommends.reason: [Compatible] Wall Builder tags the walls it makes through Tagger.

recommends.title: DS Terrain Designer
recommends.reason: [Compatible] Forced movement follows the terrain’s slopes and heights, and High Ground uses its edges.

recommends.title: Draw Steel: Token Override
recommends.reason: [Compatible] A squad’s Stamina bar follows its Squad Threshold Marks setting, and doubled up health labels are hidden.

recommends.title: Draw Steel - Combat Tracker
recommends.reason: [Compatible] Every minion of a squad shows as able to act during the squad’s turn.

recommends.title: Draw Steel - Ability HUD
recommends.reason: [Compatible] The HUD’s triggered action button follows the tracker here, for everyone at the table.

recommends.title: Health Estimate
recommends.reason: [Compatible] What it shows for a minion in a squad follows the Minion Health Estimate Display setting.

recommends.title: Draw Steel - Encounter Builder
recommends.reason: [Recommended] Easily build Draw Steel encounters to budget.

recommends.title: Draw Steel - Resources UI
recommends.reason: [Recommended] Puts all of the resource gain and spend in one place!

recommends.title: Hand Drawn Tokens for Draw Steel by Max Hamm
recommends.reason: [Recommended] Hand drawn token art for Draw Steel monsters by Max Hamm

recommends.title: Draw Steel - Hideout
recommends.reason: [Recommended] Makes it easier to run Downtime and keep track of projects.

recommends.title: Z Scatter
recommends.reason: [Recommended] Helpful for features where creatures share a space.

recommends.title: Visual Active Effects
recommends.reason: [Recommended] Makes conditions and effects easier to read and toggle.

recommends.title: Smart Target
recommends.reason: [Recommended] Targeting by keyboard, an alternative to the Combat Tools pickers.

conflicts.title: Draw Steel Plus
conflicts.reason: It should work, and does today, but newer features here are not fitted to its restyled sheets and messages, and keeping up with it is not planned.
